the reaction of dichlorocarbenes with the enamine of 3,3-disubstituted 3,4- dihydroisoquinolones results in the formation, depending on the reaction conditions and the substituents in the starting compounds, of either 3-benzoxazepinones or 3-benzthiepines. 1,2,4-Triazines as potential precursors of 1,2,5-oxadiazoles

the chemistry of 1-methylidene-1,2-dihydroiso-quinolines and the reaction of dichlorocar-bene with 3-substituted 3,4-di-hydroisoquinolones.

the dichlorocarbonylation of the 1,2,4,6-tetrahydropyridine ring system is accompanied by the migration of the enamine double bond and the simultaneous formation of a new double bond between the nitrogen atom and the carbon of the chloroform molecule.
the reaction of dichlorocarbenes with the 3,4- dihydroisoquinolins and 1-methyl-1,3,3,4- tetrahydroisoquinols is a general reaction which results in formation of a variety of products.
dichlorocarbonylation of 3,4-disubstituted 3,4- dihydroisoquinolones results in the formation either of a gemdichlorozirine or an aza-dienone, depending upon the nature of the 4-substituent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the reaction of dichlorocarbon with substituted 3-hydroxy-1,2-dihydroiso-quinolines and substituted 3,3-disubstituted-3,4- dihydroisoquinolones is highly dependent on the nature of the substituent(s) on the 3,4- tetrahydroisoquinone ring.
the reaction of dichlorocarbenes with substituted 3-methylene-1-alkylisoquinolines leads to the formation of a variety of heterocyclic compounds.

dichlorocarbenezinc chloride in acetone reacts with 3,4-di- and 1,2,4-trihydroisoquinoline derivatives in a manner which depends on the nature of the substituents on the isoquinoline ring and on the nature of substituents on nitrogen.

the reaction of dichlorocarbenes with substituted 3-heteroarylpropenes can result in the formation of either 1-azabutadienes or 3-azaspirolactones.
the reaction of dichlorocarbonate with 1,2,4-trisubstituted 3,4,5,6-tetrahydropyridines results in the stereoselective formation of the gem-dichloroazetino[3,2-b]pyridines.
